lines.zh: 我的头先过去，身体在后面跟着。
lines.en: My head goes first; the body follows.
I grind forward, pushing the earth aside.
Section by section, my body follows.
I pass beneath the clouds.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住整片山谷。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole valley.
I turn slowly, with effort.

lines.zh: 地表的树被我的身体压断。
lines.en: My body snaps the trees on the surface.

lines.zh: 我往前走，石头在我下面碎。
lines.en: I advance, and the stone below crushes.

lines.zh: 我的头在空中抬起，又落下。
lines.en: My head lifts in the air, then dips.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片互相摩擦，响成一片。
lines.en: My scales grind against each other.
My head hangs, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 我身下的地面一直在下沉。
lines.en: The ground beneath me keeps sinking.
I scan this world.

lines.zh: 我的身体盘绕着整座山。
lines.en: My body coils around a whole mountain.
I make a very low rumble.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得我认真的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone worth my effort.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上反着暗红的光。
lines.en: Dark red light reflects off my scales.

lines.zh: 风在我身边打旋，散不开。
lines.en: Wind spirals around me and can't escape.
I remember swallowing a dragon.

lines.zh: 我的每一节都在微微地动。
lines.en: Every segment of me stirs a little.

lines.zh: 空气在我附近变得很重。
lines.en: The air grows heavy near me.

lines.zh: 我从鳞缝里缓缓地呼气。
lines.en: I breathe out slowly through my scales.

lines.zh: 这片天空对我来说太低了。
lines.en: This sky is too low for me.

lines.zh: 我在想，这一次能撑多久。
lines.en: I wonder how long this one will last.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，看着远方。
lines.en: I rear up and look into the distance.
There is no end to my body.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，小得几乎看不见。
lines.en: You stand there, almost invisible.
I lower my head to you.
Your gear is quite good.
You've come alone?

lines.zh: 你在我瞳孔里只有一个小点。
lines.en: In my pupil you're barely a dot.
Let's see how long you can stand.

lines.zh: 你手里那件武器，我认得。
lines.en: I know that weapon in your hand.
You retreat, and my head sinks lower.
You're not the first to come.

lines.zh: 我的身子很长，头只到一半。
lines.en: My body is long — this head is barely half.

lines.zh: 我的上下颌缓缓分开了。
lines.en: My jaws part slowly.
You still have a chance to turn back.
A crack opens in my scales.

lines.zh: 这一点痛，我已很久没有。
lines.en: That pain is one I haven't felt in ages.

lines.zh: 我的一节身体沉了一下。
lines.en: One segment of me sags.
I draw my head back a little.
The ground presses deeper under me.
I turn slowly toward you.
There's metal in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这点伤，连我的鳞都没穿透。
lines.en: That didn't even get through my scales.
I lift my head again and look at you.
I'll remember this fight.
That dragon, I swallowed.

lines.zh: 你身上有一点龙的味道。
lines.en: You carry a trace of dragon.

lines.zh: 这点光，引不起我的兴趣。
lines.en: That little light doesn't interest me.
I lower my head and sniff.
What you hold is only iron.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地凑近，挪了一段。
lines.en: I slide a segment nearer.

lines.zh: 这世上没有能喂饱我的。
lines.en: Nothing in this world can fill me.

lines.zh: 你举着它，像是在等什么。
lines.en: You hold it up as if waiting for something.
I tilt my head your way.

lines.zh: 再靠近，你就看不到我了。
lines.en: Closer, and you won't see me anymore.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞一座山。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a mountain.

lines.zh: 我的身体推过来，把你挤开。
lines.en: My body presses and shoves you aside.
I shift a segment to give you room.
You have nowhere left to retreat.
That contact sends you flying.
My scales rake your armor.
I lower my head and my breath presses down.

lines.zh: 地面被我们压出一个凹坑。
lines.en: We press a hollow into the ground.

lines.zh: 你贴着我，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: You're against me. I barely notice.
I work around you, unhurried.

lines.zh: 另一个头从地底升起来。
lines.en: Another head rises from below.

lines.zh: 我们的身体在地底交缠。
lines.en: Our bodies entwine underground.
It's longer than I, and older.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞互相摩擦发光。
lines.en: Our scales rub and glow.

lines.zh: 两个头并排悬着，像两轮暗日。
lines.en: Two heads hang like dark suns.

lines.zh: 我们一起压塌了一座山。
lines.en: Together we crush a mountain down.

lines.zh: 它认得我吞过的那条龙。
lines.en: It knew the dragon I swallowed.
Two colossi need no talk.
We divide this underworld between us.

lines.zh: 世界对我们来说太小了。
lines.en: The world is too small for us.
I draw it into my mouth.
That metal isn't enough to fill a tooth.
I lower my head and crush it.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到你脚边，我捡了。
lines.en: Something rolled to your feet; I take it.

lines.zh: 我把它吞下去，没尝出味道。
lines.en: I swallow it and taste nothing.
I keep this netherite.

lines.zh: 我的舌头卷起地面的一层。
lines.en: My tongue peels a layer off the ground.

lines.zh: 它太小了，我差点没看见。
lines.en: It's so small I nearly missed it.
I press it under a scale.
I never keep such things.

lines.zh: 你唤醒了不该唤醒的东西。
lines.en: You've woken what shouldn't be woken.
I know your gear.
The ender dragon; I swallowed it first.
This fight will likely drag on.
The ground has started to give.
Don't think you can run.
Every segment of me is awake.

lines.zh: 火球的引信在我喉咙里点燃。
lines.en: A fireball's fuse lights in my throat.

lines.zh: 像你这样的，我吞过很多。
lines.en: I've swallowed many like you.
I'm prepared to be serious.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，是我的猎场。
lines.en: Where you stand is my hunting ground.
The sky tightens above me.

lines.zh: Doombeam 的光点在你四周浮现。
lines.en: Points of Doombeam light surface all around you.
I count three, then swallow you.
My body begins to close around.
This time I hold nothing back.
I lower my head and aim.

lines.zh: 末影龙的骨头还卡在我牙间。
lines.en: The ender dragon's bone is still stuck between my teeth.
I spread my body and surround you.

lines.zh: 你退到哪，我就在哪出现。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, I'm there.
My head never leaves you.
The ground rumbles under me.

lines.zh: 我在算你最远能跑多远。
lines.en: I'm estimating how far you can run.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片一块块亮起来。
lines.en: My scales light one by one.
The air is heating.
Your back is to me. Dangerous.
My mouth opens a crack.
I coil into two rings.
You're in my very center.
All this sky is mine.

lines.zh: 我的节与节之间在收紧。
lines.en: My segments draw tighter.

lines.zh: 你在原地转圈，我看见了。
lines.en: You circle in place. I see it.
No hurry; you won't get far.
My head rises into the clouds.
Light begins to leak from my sides.

lines.zh: 我的节节身段把荒地围成圈。
lines.en: My segmented length rings the wasteland.
I coil behind you.
The last pass begins.
My head slams down and the earth splits.
A segment sweeps past your feet.
You're driven into the rock face.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整条身体的重量。
lines.en: That carried my whole body's weight.
My teeth graze your pauldron.
A crater collapses.
You're flung into the air.
I rear up and come down again.
Your armor cracks audibly.
That strike isn't finished.
My body starts to coil around you.

lines.zh: 你居然还站着，我有点意外。
lines.en: You're actually still up. That's a surprise.
I open my mouth and light gathers.
Your knees hit the ground.
The earth splits, and my head shows first.

lines.zh: 云层被我的头撞开一道口。
lines.en: My head knocks a gap in the cloud deck.

lines.zh: 远处的云被什么东西推开。
lines.en: Clouds are pushed aside by something.
The dragon's cry cuts off.

lines.zh: 我吞掉了那条龙，然后来了。
lines.en: I swallowed that dragon, then I came.
A long shadow appears on the ridge.
The world seems to press down.

lines.zh: 我从地底一节节升上来。
lines.en: I rise from below, section by section.
A pillar of light finds me through cloud.
Everyone here should look up.
My head hangs among the clouds.

lines.zh: 我的第一声震动传得很远。
lines.en: My first rumble carries far.

lines.zh: 我把身体铺满了整片荒地。
lines.en: I lay my body across the whole waste.
The wind stops. I have come.
The shadow on the ground grows vast.
You've come at just the right time.

lines.zh: 山脉在我身下变得很小。
lines.en: The mountains shrink beneath me.
This hunt begins now.

lines.zh: 我从云里垂下来，认准了地面。
lines.en: I hang down from the clouds, fixed on the ground.
I've come to eat.

lines.zh: 火在我鳞上散开，像风里的灰。
lines.en: Fire scatters off my scales like ash in wind.

lines.zh: 我从高空沉下去，砸塌了一座山。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and crush a mountain.
Water covers my head. Suffocating.

lines.zh: 爆风只推得我偏了一寸。
lines.en: The blast turns me one inch.

lines.zh: 一枚弹打在我的牙上，弹开了。
lines.en: A round strikes my tooth and bounces away.

lines.zh: 法术缠着我的鳞，有点麻。
lines.en: That spell clings to my scales and numbs them.
I haven't eaten in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，从我每一节流过。
lines.en: Lightning runs through every segment of me.

lines.zh: 虚空在吞我，我也在吞它。
lines.en: The void devours me; I devour it back.
